lines: Perumal Ramamurthy Srinivasan, an Investor Selling Shareholder, is selling up to 6,750 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of up to ₹0.91 crore, if all offered shares are sold; the money has been in hand since 11 Mar 2026.
Their retained shares, an estimate of ₹2.13 crore at offer price, unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, so more value is available later.
The unlock was 67 days ago and the shares are sold at a discount for employees, so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
